# Run 2 — 2026-09-16 (deliverable 2: curated coarse-dataset adapters)

## Spec / Base / Branch / Config

- **Spec:** `docs/tickets/P25.4__live-data-driven-and-international.md` — deliverable 2
  (the deep half), stacked on P25.5.
- **Branch:** `devin/p25-4-coarse-adapters` — **stacked on `devin/p25-5-live-extraction`**
  (base `7b52f2b`); implement-spec dispatch.

## What landed

1. **`carnegie_ai_gsi` adapter — embedded-dataset surface.** The AI Global Surveillance
   Index page is a Next.js client-rendered interactive; the reviewed dataset lives in one
   of the page's `<script src>` chunk files as a minified per-country array
   (`{country, id, chinese, us, city, facial, policing, description, relevant-companies…}`).
   `discover_more` resolves the page's chunk links into bounded `dataset_chunk` targets
   (`max_dataset_targets`, reviewed bound — a page that grew more chunks is `ContentDrift`);
   the chunk carrying the reviewed `entry_marker` parses STRICTLY (all 75 entries must match
   the full field shape or the whole capture fails loud). Emits per-country membership +
   five typed boolean flag claims + vendor supplier claims — 660 claims live.
2. **`facial_recognition_world_map` adapter — Google-Sheets surface.** The Surfshark map
   page links a Google Sheet; the reviewed spec resolves six continent gviz-CSV sheets
   (name + gid bound in vocab). Strict five-column header check, strict six-sheet closure —
   a changed/added/renamed sheet or header is `ContentDrift`. 194 data rows / 193 unique
   countries (Egypt appears twice with conflicting statuses — **both rows preserved**, never
   silently reconciled) → 202 claims live.
3. **`aspi_mapping_chinas_tech_giants` — still WAF-blocked.** Local egress and the Cloud
   Run vantage probe both answer HTTP 403; alternate ASPI hosts reachable but the relevant
   report/map paths stay blocked. No bypass, no fabricated vendor-country rows — the run
   records an `access_restricted` disappearance. Egress/HG-04 outreach stays owed to
   P25.7 d3.
4. **Versioned vocabulary** — `data/coarse_international_vocab.toml` carries the adapter
   specs (surface kinds, entry markers, sheet names+gids, predicate allowlist, forbidden
   non-aggregate column tokens) and all 193 reviewed FRWM country-name → subject-id
   mappings (incl. `GB-ENG`/`GB-SCT`, `XK`, `FM`, `SZ`, `GM`, `TL`).
5. **Evidence/locators/dates** — every adapter claim carries `{source_url, retrieved_date,
   extraction_method, locator}`; Carnegie locators are byte-ranges into the captured chunk,
   FRWM locators are sheet rows/cells; `observed_at` stamped from the capture's retrieval
   timestamp.
6. **`parsing/document.py`** — `html_script_srcs` (pure byte-level `<script src>`
   extraction) added alongside the P25.5 helpers.

## Acceptance evidence (run 2)

- LIVE 2026-09-16 (`docs/build/reports/live_runs/2026-09-16_*.json`):
  - `carnegie_ai_gsi` → **660 claims**, 29 captures (page + bounded chunk set), no drift.
  - `facial_recognition_world_map` → **202 claims**, 7 captures (page + 6 sheets), no drift.
  - `aspi_mapping_chinas_tech_giants` → 0 claims/0 captures, recorded
    `access_restricted` disappearance (WAF 403, never defeated).
- `tests/connectors/test_coarse_dataset_adapters.py` (18 tests): claim content +
  evidence/timestamp/locator assertions, chunk-link discovery bound, chunk/sheet/page
  shape drift → `ContentDrift`, forbidden-column + unlisted-predicate refusal,
  changed-snapshot → new dated claims never overwrites, shadow replay diff = 0,
  aspi stays document-capture-only.
- `tests/connectors` + `tests/parsing`: 701 passed, 1 skipped (env-gated leak check).
- Missing live target → `NoLiveTargets` refusal (exit 4) verified on a green source with
  no configured row (`declarationcamera_be`).
- `make check`, `check_backlog.py`, `check-build-memory.sh` green.

## Owed (after run 2)

- **aspi egress** — a vantage the WAF does not challenge (the Cloud Run probe returned 403)
  or HG-04 outreach → P25.7 d3. The adapter emits nothing until a permitted
  machine-readable surface exists.
- `D-P21.8-1` stays **PARTIAL** — the curated adapters landed for carnegie/FRWM;
  aspi's live lane is still egress-blocked.
